description: Receive a client document into an engagement BY REFERENCE — a client-granted signed https link (or an upload handle), never the file's contents. The engine fetches it server-side, stages it inside the client's tenant for certification, and tells you only the column names and where to certify the mapping — no row of the client's data ever passes through the model. Resolves the matching PBC open item. This is how the data gets in without it ever touching the model: 'no LLM on the money path' stays literally true.

engagement_id.description: The engagement this document belongs to.

kind.description: Which stream this is (pos = sell-through, claims = billbacks, credits = credit memos).

signed_url.description: A client-granted signed https link to the file (e.g. a Drive/SharePoint export). The engine fetches it directly; you do NOT paste the file contents.

upload_handle.description: Alternatively, a handle to a file already uploaded to the client's tenant store.

name: receive_document
